findings.reason: The original standalone tiles contain no diagram. A concrete two-vertex graph with a tree edge and a loop materially clarifies the induction: the same edge-group data produce an amalgam after killing the tree symbol and an HNN extension for the loop. The four embedding maps make the conjugacy orientation explicit. This warrants an explanatory illustration under the expanded diagram criterion, although the proof remains independent.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Graph X has vertices v,w, tree edge f:v→w and loop e:w→w. T contains f and both vertices.
diagram_math_checks.check: T is connected, spans X, and contains no cycle; the unique additional loop is outside T. The actual native render has two circular vertices and two geometric edges, with one directed connecting edge and one directed loop.

diagram_math_checks.maps: alpha_f:G_f→G_v; alpha_bar f:G_f→G_w; alpha_e:G_e→G_w; alpha_bar e:G_e→G_w.
diagram_math_checks.check: The domains and codomains follow def-graph-of-groups: alpha_h targets G_o(h), alpha_bar h targets G_t(h). All four drawn arrows point from the edge group to its vertex group. Repeated G_w nodes in the loop span are explicitly identified as the same group, not distinct vertices. No commutative square is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.relation: f alpha_bar f(a) f^{-1}=alpha_f(a), then f=1 gives alpha_bar f(a)=alpha_f(a).
diagram_math_checks.check: This is the exact relation of def-path-group-of-a-graph-of-groups with h=f and the quotient of def-fundamental-group-of-a-graph-of-groups-relative-to-a-maximal-tree. It yields the amalgam A=G_v *_G_f G_w, as in local proof step 1.2.

diagram_math_checks.relation: e alpha_bar e(b) e^{-1}=alpha_e(b), with the maps viewed inside A.
diagram_math_checks.check: This is the exact path-group conjugacy convention, with e outside T. Against def-hnn-extension-and-stable-letter, t=e, alpha=alpha_bar e, beta=alpha_e; the direction is not silently reversed.

diagram_math_checks.relation: A reversal h g bar h is a cancellation pattern when g lies in alpha_bar h(G_h); reduced words exclude that pattern.
diagram_math_checks.check: This is precisely def-reduced-graph-of-groups-word. The coefficient is at t(h), the codomain of alpha_bar h, so the membership has the correct group. The diagram is expository and no part of the original rigorous proof depends on it.
